verdict.rationale: Paperspace offers a REST API, CLI (pspace/Gradient CLI), and Workflows for automating ML pipelines, which supports headless/CI-style usage, but there's no direct evidence of CI integration examples, webhooks, or documented headless automation patterns beyond basic API/CLI docs. missing for 10: CI/CD integration examples (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), documented non-interactive headless run patterns, independent corroboration of scripting/automation success.
